# Disagreement Log — GTH_077

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 77
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 77 | "over all things" | "above all things" | "over everything" | *hijōn ptērf*: spatial preposition |
| 2 | 77 | "the all" (lowercase) | "the All" (capitalized) | "the Everything" | *ptērf*: cosmic term — capitalization and rendering |
| 3 | 77 | "to me the all attained" | "to me all things have returned" | "all things reached me" | Eschatological return: *attain* vs. return vs. reach |
| 4 | 77 | "a piece of wood" | "a piece of wood" | "a log of wood" | Wood description |
| 5 | 77 | "Lift up the stone" | "Lift up a stone" | "Pick up a stone" | Stone lifting verb and article |
| 6 | 77 | "you will find me there" | "you will find me there" | "you will find me underneath it" | Location specification — "there" vs. "underneath" |

**Total disagreements: 6**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "over all things," "the All" (capitalized as cosmic term), "attained" (preserves the specific verb), "a piece of wood," "Lift up the stone," and "find me there" (not spatially specified beyond presence).
